audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text is generic; the page never states WHY the lane flips, and the full-layer level chart reads 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Sylas/Sylas/Sylas — two different answers to the same question.
audit.why: Karma owns levels 1-4 (950-range Inner Flame, Sylas has no gap-closer until Abscond at 3 and pays 55 mana per Chain Lash). Sylas owns 6+ because Hijack (80/55/30s) takes Mantra outright and Kingslayer (12/10.5/9/7.5/6s) heals the trade back.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to the content layer and the packet levelChart; phases[4..6].why rewritten so the sentence matches the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text invented a 'Q-parry' Sylas does not have.
audit.why: Sylas's kit is Petricite Burst / Chain Lash / Kingslayer / Abscond-Abduct / Hijack. Nothing in it parries.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and content.early rewritten around the real spikes: Abscond at 3, Hijack at 6, Kingslayer scaling to a 6s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond/Abduct described as 'Dash into chain-stun'. Abduct is a chain-pull that drags Sylas to the target — it does not stun.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.'
audit.corrected: Named and described correctly in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, with the real 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Abscond 13s rank 1 / 9s rank 5 and Kingslayer 12s rank 1 now stated.

audit.why: Grievous Wounds is already called for in report[8] against Kingslayer sustain, matching the missingInteractions needs-antiheal rule.

edits.before: No new ult — your 6 is a Mantra rank: faster cycles, bigger RQs. Press the early lead before scaling lanes wake up.
edits.after: Hijack lands at 80s rank 1 and takes your Mantra the moment you cast it near him — hold it until his R is spent.

edits.before: Blackfire/Luden's spike: RQ-W chains threaten kills outright. The lane is now or never — you fall off politely.
edits.after: His first item turns Abscond into a kill: E in, Q slow, Kingslayer heals it back. Shield the dash and root the recast.

edits.before: Late Karma is a utility engine: RE shields the team, W roots the diver, and RQ pokes the objective setup.
edits.after: Hijack drops to 30s and recycles your best ult each fight — you peel: RE the engage, W-root him off the carry.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget RE shield-speed for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Abscond (E) is 13s at rank 1 and still 9s at rank 5: after he dashes and recasts Abduct, that whole window is free Q-poke. - Kingslayer (W) heals him every 12s at rank 1 — trade after he burns it, never into it.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Abscond is 13s at rank 1 — bait the dash, count it, then Q-W him while he cannot leave.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.
edits.after: Shield the Abscond dash with E, then W-root him as he lands — the tether holds him through the recast and your CC lands on a static Sylas.

edits.before: Sylas spends Abscond / Abduct early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Sylas roams once the wave clears — crash it and ping him before Hijack hits another lane.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Post-items Kingslayer heals through your poke — shield the dive, root him instead.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: With your E shield down you have no answer to Abscond into Kingslayer — hold the wave back until the shield is up.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Hijacking your Mantra, closing with Abscond, and healing the trade back with Kingslayer every 12 seconds.

edits.before: Ahead, sprint: RQ Sylas off every wave, take plates with the lead, and W-root river picks — Karma leads are sprints, not marathons.
edits.after: Ahead, deny scaling: RQ him off the wave while Abscond is down, take plates, and W-root him whenever he steps up to farm at range.

edits.before: Carry early or enable late — RQ chips win lanes; RE + roots win the teamfights your early lead bought.
edits.after: Carry the level 1-4 window with RQ chip; after 6 you win by holding Mantra until his Hijack is spent.

edits.before: If Sylas takes first blood, tighten up: Abscond / Abduct is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q and stay relevant through shields and roots.
edits.after: If Sylas takes first blood, Kingslayer makes every trade profitable for him — stop poking into it, farm with Q at 950 range, and bank Mantra for RE on his dives rather than spending it on the wave.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Abscond (E): he dashes, then recasts Abduct to chain-pull himself onto you. It is 13s at rank 1 — step up on its downtime.

edits.before: Sylas is mana-locked on his Q spam and has no gap closer yet; poke him with Q/E and punish any Q-parry attempt since his E dash is on a long cooldown.
edits.after: Sylas has no gap-closer until Abscond, and Chain Lash costs 55 mana a cast; poke from 950 range and step up while his E sits on its 13s cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you win trades outright since Sylas has no dash until E unlocks and his Q parry is easily played around by just poking from max range with Inner Flame. This holds through levels 3-5 as his mana pool can't support constant Q spam, so keep denying CS and chipping his HP whenever his E is down.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you win trades outright since Sylas has no dash until Abscond unlocks at 3, so poke from 950 range with Inner Flame and walk out of Chain Lash's delayed explosion. This holds through 3-5 as 55 mana a Q drains him, so deny CS and chip him whenever Abscond's 13 seconds are ticking.
